name: call-of-cthulhu-plugin
description: Create and roll guest Call of Cthulhu investigator sheets, display inline roll results and share dice events through private play sessions.

interface.longDescription: An editable Call of Cthulhu 7th edition investigator sheet with characteristics, skills, health, sanity, luck, weapons, backstory and possessions. No account required. Drafts stay in your browser where the host permits; export JSON for a portable backup. Display dice results inline in chat. Optionally connect a private guest play session to share dice events with an explicitly subscribed chat. Sessions expire after 24 hours and retain up to 1,000 rolls. Explicitly attach a draft to share it with ChatGPT. Cloud saving and Quest Portal accounts are planned for a later release.
defaultPrompt: Open my Call of Cthulhu investigator sheets.
Help me create a Call of Cthulhu investigator.
